messages:
Maya: Quick UX Q for the private/on‑prem setup wizard — can we surface probe results as a compact actionable summary (what to fix) and hide raw logs under an expandable 'details' section? Figma frame here: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE

Devon: 100% — actionable summary + one‑click 'copy diagnostic' sounds ideal. Also agree on collapsing logs by default. +1 for a short 'why this matters' line per failed check.

Alex: We can do a summary pill (green/yellow/red) + 1‑line explanation. Implementation note: backend currently returns a plaintext blob; we'll need a small API change to return structured checks (code, status, short_message, raw_log_url). cc @ops-bot for current probe payload.

ops-bot: Probe run: 2026-03-18T09:14:23Z — 6 passed, 3 failed. Raw logs: https://internal/probes/2169876543/log.txt. Available fields: status, stdout, stderr.

Jamal: If we rely on color, add explicit text (Pass/Warning/Fail) and ensure aria-live updates while scan runs. Keyboard users need a clear focus order through the summary -> details toggle.

Keisha: Draft microcopy suggestion:
```
Connectivity checks found 3 issues. Fix these to continue setup.
- View details
- Copy diagnostic
```
For individual errors: "SSH to host failed — confirm firewall allows egress on port 22." Short, actionable.

Maya: Nice. Also propose an inline one‑sentence helper under each failed item: e.g., "Why this matters: the agent needs outbound SSH to pull the image." Keeps users from jumping to support.

Devon: Can we flag 'collapse logs by default' behind a feature flag so we can A/B test whether users click 'View details'?

Alex: That's doable. Frontend can read flag and set collapsed=true. We'll need a mapping table for error_code -> KB slug for the 'learn more' links. Who owns that mapping?

Keisha: I can draft mapping for the top 10 most common errors this week and write concise KB blurbs.

Jamal: Accessibility nit — don't hide content from screen readers using display:none; use aria-hidden appropriately and ensure a hidden visually-only summary is still readable by SRs if needed. Also announce test completion with aria-live="polite".

Maya: Thanks — I'll update the Figma frames with the pill, inline helpers, and the collapsed details pattern and post the new link by EOD. Tagging @Keisha and @Jamal for copy + accessibility review.

Alex: Timeline: need backend contract by Friday (fields: code, status, message, kb_slug, raw_url), frontend PR early next week.

Devon: SGTM. Scheduling a 20m sync Thu 11:00 to lock API fields and copy. :thumbsup:
